method: Exact .179 firmware IDA disassembly and decompilation (vela_ap_4.100.179.bin.i64, input SHA256 verified against target.toml), cross-checked against the reviewed .155 audit; no device execution. All constants below are established from .179-local instructions, not inherited from .155.
observations: lv_event_get_indev at 0x0c37fc70 (52 bytes): LDRH event code at event+8, checks (code-1) <= 0x11 with whitelist mask 0x3bdff (codes 1..18), then returns the borrowed parameter pointer at event+16; failure path logs the lv_obj_event.c:202 lv_event_get_indev assertion and returns NULL.

lv_indev_get_point at 0x0c399b90 (36 bytes, byte-identical to the reviewed .155 body): copies two signed 32-bit coordinates from indev+56/+60; NULL indev reports 0,0 and a non-pointer input reports -1,-1.

lv_obj_get_scroll_y at 0x0c37ff8c (14 bytes, byte-identical to .155): loads spec_attr at object+8 and returns the negation of the signed vertical scroll value at spec_attr+36, or zero without attributes. Called by the reviewed lv_obj_scroll_to_y 0x0c38438c and align_to 0x0c383f3c. Neighbour 0x0c37ff46 is get_scroll_x (spec_attr+32).

lv_obj_scroll_to_y at 0x0c38438c accepts object, y and animation flag, deletes the running animation, reads the current scroll_y via 0x0c37ff8c and scrolls by the difference; consistent with EVID-LYRA-UI-4179-001.

lv_obj_update_layout at 0x0c383f00 (56 bytes, body SHA256 324435ff22516191c749e69e1f7eb04a6ac5386551579c39e78d27ff9ed12148): refreshes the root layout; native object screen rectangles are four signed 32-bit fields at +28,+32,+36,+40, corroborated by align_to 0x0c383f3c and lvx_image_set_scale 0x0c3ae3d6. FW_UI_COORD_TYPE int32_t, FW_UI_OBJECT_COORDS_OFFSET 28. These private offsets are never exposed to modules.

Event ABI in .179: code is a uint16 at event+8 (read with & 0x7fff), user_data pointer at event+12, parameter at event+16; event-send core 0x0c37fb98 and dispatcher 0x0c3a3e0c use exactly these offsets. Codes verified in .179 senders: PRESSED 1 / PRESSING 2 / PRESS_LOST 3 from the press processor 0x0c39b008, LONG_PRESSED 5 from 0x0c3964c8, RELEASED 8 from 0x0c396d3c and gesture processor 0x0c39ebdc (which also emits CLICKED 7), SCROLL 12 from 0x0c38238e, DELETE 36 from lvx_object_delete 0x0c3813ac before child/class destruction, VALUE_CHANGED 30 from encoder senders.

Style wrappers forward the same property IDs as the .155 audit: radius 12 (wrapper 0x0c3a88d4, byte-identical to .155 0x0c3a89a8), border color 49 (0x0c3a878a), border width 48 (0x0c3a87bc), border opacity 50 (0x0c3a87a8), text font 90 (0x0c3a88ac, MOVS R1,#0x5A), opacity 95 (0x0c4fe910), clip corner 45 (0x0c384e60, adjacent to the radius write). RGB values keep the 0xRRGGBB packed representation.
lvx_page_title_create (.179 0x0c89cc1c binding) retains the reviewed private layout: click code 7 bound to the back icon and text label children, never the title root.

align_to 0x0c383f3c adds the parent scroll_y from 0x0c37ff8c before setting style coordinates (x property 8, y property 9). Parent-relative content coordinates must subtract that scroll_y before calling align_to, exactly as documented for .155.
ownership: All native UI calls and borrowed event/indev/object reads execute synchronously on the firmware UI owner task. Input pointers are valid only during the native callback.
limitations: Static evidence only. No new device verification or production approval. Other firmware addresses must be established independently.
